newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PriceCostco cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PriceCostco cut to hold.

text.p: -- Lazard Freres & Co said Friday it downgraded PriceCostco Inc to hold from buy based on the appreciation of the company's shares since October 30.
-- Lazard Freres said the stock has appreciated 39 percent since October 30 and has surpassed its price target of $25.
-- Lazard Freres also noted that PriceCostco is currently trading at 20.3 times its earnings projection of $1.31 a share for the 12 months that ended November 1996.
-- Although same-store sales improved by eight percent in the most recent quarter and by 10 percent in December, comparable store sales are unlikely to continue at this pace, Lazard Freres said.
-- PriceCostco operates a warehouse-club retail chain.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/4 Friday at 26-3/8.
